column2: WHEREAS  the  13th    Amendment  to  the  Constitution
(hereafter referred to as the 13th  Amendment) provides-

column3: for the enactment of laws relating to Law and Order
including  prevention,  detection  and  investigation
of offences and replacement of the existing laws of
Parliament  by  Provincial  Councils.(Vide  Article
154G(8) read with the Item 12:1 of the Appendix I
of List 1 of the 9th  Schedule);
that the Deputy Inspector General of Police who is
the Head of the Provincial Division of the Police
Force is responsible to and be under the control of
the Chief Minister (Vide Item 11:1 of the Appendix
1 of List 1 of the 9th Schedule);
two of the three members of the Provincial Police
Commission to be appointed upon the nomination
or  with  concurrence  of  the  Chief  Minister  and

thereby  politicizing 
the  Provincial  Police

Commission 
entrusted  with 
recruitments,
promotions,  transfers  and  disciplinary  control  of
police  officers  of  Provincial  Police  Force.  (Vide
Items 4, 6 and 9:1 of Appendix I of  List 1 of the 9th
Schedule read with Article 155G(1)(b));
that  members of the National Police Force serving
in  a  province  is  required  to  function  under  the
directions  and  control  of  the  Deputy  Inspector
General of the Police of the Province who is in turn
responsible  to  and  under  control  of  the  Chief
Minister. (Vide Item 11 of Appendix I of List 1 of
the 9th Schedule);
